description: This file is a Perl test script for the lighttpd web server, specifically testing the SCGI module by sending various HTTP requests and verifying responses including different line endings and specific WSGI environment variables.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A class providing methods for testing the lighttpd server, including starting/stopping the server and handling HTTP requests.

methods.description: Constructor for creating a new LightyTest object.
